**Finding: MINCOMMIT — Compliant (meets the preferred position).**

- **No commitment binds us.** Section 3 is a pure revenue share: 30% of Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly floor, reconciled quarterly for refunds/exchanges. We pay only on sales actually made through the Site — no minimum spend, guaranteed volume, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic anywhere in the Agreement (targeted searches for "minimum", "commit", "volume", "guaranteed", "shortfall" returned nothing).
- **No volume caps on our usage**, and the term is one year with auto-renewal terminable by either Party on 90 days' notice (§ 4.1), so there is no multi-year take-or-pay exposure — the walk-away scenario is not present.
- **Noted, not flagged here:** the § 4.2 Termination Payment (trailing 12-month Net Sales less $800,000, halved, in eight quarterly instalments) is an exit fee / liquidated-damages mechanic, not a minimum purchase commitment — it is not measured against any committed volume and cannot be cured by purchasing more. That belongs to the termination/liquidated-damages rules and should not be double-flagged under MINCOMMIT. Likewise the § 6.1 exclusivity restraint is a competitive restriction, properly reviewed under EXCLUSIVITY.

No redline proposed, consistent with the instruction not to redline a clause that already sits at (indeed above) the fallback.
